revision_summary: One quote timestamp error and one internal classification contradiction need fixing before ship: (1) cherry_pick_moments[6] cites ts 01:36 for a quote that actually begins around 01:50-02:08 ('they were basically saying, oh, we can install this...I don't hear what you think it means.') — correct the timestamp. (2) cherry_pick_moments[0] (ts 00:58) is labeled classification 'setter_scope_creep' but the stewart_read text explicitly says this is NOT scope creep — rename the classification field to something like 'unlogged_technical_requirement' or 'missed_handoff_capture' so the label doesn't contradict the schema's actual definition of scope_creep (which is rep-driven, per coaching_philosophy.setter_scope_discipline.scope_creep_signals). Additionally: tighten bill_anchor_audit's bill_ts — 07:21 is when the customer says she's about to send the screenshot, not when it's confirmed received (~08:00-08:11); add the customer's confirmation-call/voicemail instructions (~10:08-11:33) to the handoff_brief as a channel-preference detail the closer's scheduling team needs; and soften trajectory_verdict tone slightly to acknowledge the customer's near-continuous monologue gave the rep limited natural openings to probe, rather than framing all missed probes as pure rep failure.
